decisions.reason: ACE3 is a flagship distributed ALCMS solution at the heart of the firm's airfield lighting business, so even with pandemic-depressed airport spending it stays central to future performance against aspirations.

The air situation display complements the surveillance and tower portfolio at low marginal cost, but as a peripheral software item it is a candidate for consolidation if the aviation downturn triggers problemistic search.
The airport systems training program needs little capital and supports the installed base and service revenue, so it is worth carrying through the downturn.
The airfield ground lighting training course is tied directly to the core lighting business and is cheap to maintain, so dropping it would free few resources.
The collaboration software supports the firm's airport-wide digital strategy, and its uncertain early results can be tolerated while traffic recovers.

Multilateration is outside the core lighting competence and is costly to develop, so shortfalls during COVID raise the risk of a drop, but its recent launch and strategic surveillance value favour keeping it for now.
